summary: The comment emphasizes the importance of reliable internet access for education and supports tying E-Rate decisions to educational outcomes to ensure students have access to necessary digital resources for learning.

claims.requested_action: Tie E-Rate decisions to educational outcomes
claims.argument: E-Rate should prioritize improving educational outcomes by ensuring reliable internet access for schools and students
claims.evidence_quote: Reliable school internet is crucial for our kids these days. When most of their learning is online, both at home and at school, internet connectivity without interruptions is imperative. Modern education uses computers, tablets, phones, etc. in all settings and reliable internet should remain available to all students and schools.
